amendments.by: gate-5 review, before any GPU run
changes: settings.batch: 32 on every task -> per task, 32 procedural (E256 sft_batch) and 8 lowercase (E53's lowercase.BATCH = 8, E231 batch_b 8); the old source cited a BATCH 32 that commute.lowercase does not have. Lowercase's t_ref and cap come from E53 at batch 8 and stand

rule.readable_task: also needs dial_order (Spearman of the measured residual share with d over the penalised arms) >= dial_rho_min 0.8: penalised arms collapsed onto gains only would otherwise read as a graded order

rule.cheap: share, steering, erank -> steering, erank; the re-gating share moves to rule.construction, scored and reported beside them, never counted for rival a: the dial's reuse end is a gain per VPD subcomponent and the share is computed on the same decomposition, so it agrees with the dial by construction
rule.gain_check, gain_rho_max 0.3 (new): the read gain's rho with d is reported and flags a task when it tracks (p < alpha) at |rho| > 0.3

early checks (code, thresholds unchanged): every step stops on a non-finite loss, penalty, gradient norm or read gain; each item's gains-only E_b over its changed variables is checked against eb_gain_min before its scan, not after; each Gaussian's E_b over K over eb_random_max stops the job
states saved in fp32, not bf16 (+56 MB per state, ~112 MB each): bf16 rounding moves E_b at the gains-only end; every state alike so the arms are compared at one precision
small JSONs packed in results/large/packs/json.tar after every part; calibrate written after every arm and resumable, with --arms to split lowercase over two jobs

settings.tasks_source: the cell's done_when: sequence, brackets, addition (E256's procedural tasks, experiments/procedural_rl) and one real-text task: E53's lowercase (the plan says why it replaces E233's British spelling). Listed in cost order: the pod split (run.py main) relies on it
settings.seeds_source: E256's and E53's seeds 0-2 (procedural_rl predictions.json settings.seeds; lowercase.batch_order)
settings.eb_seeds_source: the cell: E_b over K per fine-tune. The cut-down is [0] (plan, Cost)
settings.betas_source: MEASURED in the E300 rehearsal by the filed rule: median residual share over the four tasks calibrate runs b10 0.887, b100 0.886, b1000 0.883, b1e4 0.863, b1e5 0.476, b1e6 0.056; nearest 0.75 = 1e4, 0.5 = 1e5, 0.25 = 1e6. Every task has a beta in 0.1-0.9 and falls in order over the three. The penalty is beta x sum ||Res||^2 / sum ||W0||^2
settings.target_source: MEASURED in the E300 rehearsal (2026-11-24, results/rehearse/calibrate_<task>.json): per task min(t_ref, plateau_frac x the gains-only seed-0 plateau at the cap). addition and brackets = t_ref (plateau 7.96, 9.84 above it); sequence 0.9 x 5.743; lowercase 0.9 x 1.3216 (t_ref 1.64 above the plateau). None under MIN_GAIN 1
settings.t_ref_source: the ordinary fine-tunes as they ran: procedural, the mean read gain (gain.lo) of E256's three SFT states (experiments/procedural_rl/results/read/<task>_sft_s{0,1,2}.json); lowercase, E53's reference gain on E136's read rows as E231 read it (experiments/gain_only/results/items/e53_lowercase_s0.json refs.e53/lowercase.gain)
settings.plateau_frac_source: so that every gains-only seed reaches the target before its plateau (E231's lowercase gains-only run gained 1.196 at step 1500 and 1.205 at step 3000: seeds of one recipe sit within a few percent of the plateau there, experiments/gain_only/results/items/e53_lowercase_s0.json checks)
settings.lr_gain_source: E231's gain rate ((IA)^3, Liu et al. 2022, 3e-3; experiments/gain_only/results/predictions.json settings.lr), Adam, constant
settings.lr_res_source: E256's SFT and E53's rate (procedural_rl predictions.json settings.lr: Adam 3e-5, betas 0.9/0.999, no weight decay), for the residual and the ordinary fine-tune
settings.grad_clip_source: E53's, E256's and E231's (clip at 1, here per parameter group)
settings.batch_source: each task's reference recipe: E256's sft_batch 32 (procedural_rl predictions.json settings.sft_batch); E53's lowercase.BATCH 8 (src/commute/lowercase.py STEPS, BATCH = 300, 8; E231's gains-only lowercase batch_b 8, gain_only predictions.json). Lowercase's t_ref (E53's states) and cap (10 x E53's 300 steps) are at batch 8, so they stand
settings.cap_source: E231's rule (gain_only predictions.json cap_min 300, cap_mult 10): max(300, 10 x the largest step of the task's reference fine-tunes): E256's SFT steps 27/49/31 (train_<task>.json), E53's 300
settings.kl_source: E256's KL read (Pile val rows 0-63, batch 8; procedural_rl settings.kl_rows, kl_batch), on every task
settings.rand_sd_source: E231's stage-0 random gain state (gain_only predictions.json settings.rand_sd)
settings.random_seed_source: the cell number; the Gaussian of each task and stage 0's random dial
settings.rehearse_task_source: a procedural task (64-token D, the dearer E_b scan) whose E256 SFT took the median steps
settings.rehearse_eb_arms_source: the two ends of the dial get the full E_b scan at the full read sizes in the rehearsal (two scans of ~20 min each on an L40 fit the debug QoS with the reads); stage 0 reads E_b over the changed variables of a random gains-only state and its Gaussian
settings.rehearse_cap_source: past E256's SFT stop (27-49 steps) so the ordinary arm can reach its target, under every scored cap
settings.rehearse_betas_source: a decade grid wide enough to put the residual share at both ends; the calibrate job reads each

thresholds.equiv_source: E231's and E282's stage-0 bug bars (gain_only, gain_share predictions.json): an fp32 reassociation gives ~1e-6, a wrong orientation order 1
thresholds.step1_max_source: LOOSENED 2026-11-24 after it failed: was 0.5, sourced from the procedural tasks (27-49 steps to E256 gain); pod p11 (lowercase s2) stopped at step 1 gains 0.713 vs 0.5 x target 1.189 = 0.595. The rehearsal measured lowercase step 1 at 0.776 on every arm (calibrate disables this check) and its arms still spread the residual share 0.86/0.32/0.05 at the three betas, so the bar's premise (no steps left to separate the arms) does not hold for lowercase. Procedural step 1 is at most 0.21 x target. Approved by whip-lead 11-24; replaced for lowercase by rule.spread_tasks
thresholds.eb_gain_min_source: MEASURED in the E300 rehearsal: half the lower of stage 0 (e) E_b over changed variables of the random gains state, 0.8397 (addition, 4090) and 0.8669 (lowercase, H100); Gaussian 0.0127 and 0.0143. A bug bar, not a reading
thresholds.eb_random_max_source: 4 x the largest E_b of E268's matched Gaussians on these tasks (0.0129, experiments/kstar_needed/results/summary.json p256/*_random_*)
thresholds.min_gain_source: commute.local_faith.MIN_GAIN: a Gaussian reaching it stops the job (E256's do-nothing stop); a task whose target falls under it is dropped

rule.unit: within one task: every trained dial state (arms g, the betas, ft; seeds 0-2) that reached its target; the dial index d = 0 (gains only), 1..len(betas) (largest beta first), len(betas)+1 (the ordinary fine-tune)
rule.readable_task: at least min_levels dial levels each with at least min_per_level states that reached the target, and the dial's measured order (dial_order) at least dial_rho_min; an arm that cannot reach it is reported as a shorter dial, never dropped silently
rule.dial_order: Spearman (average ranks for ties) of the measured residual share (the train record's 1 - gains alone / gain) with d over the reached states of the penalised arms only (d = 1..len(betas)): the ends are 0 and 1 by construction and would carry a collapsed middle over the bar (measured on made-up shares: middle arms all in [0, 1e-3] in random order pass 0.8 on 48% of draws with the ends in, ~0% without). Undefined, so the task unreadable, when fewer than two penalised levels have a finite share or the share is constant over them; a non-finite share (gain 0) is left out
rule.dial_rho_min_source: gate-5 review (2026-11-24): a graded dial must order its penalised arms by the share it was built to set; at three seeds per level a correct order with seed noise reads ~0.9-1, a collapsed one ~0
rule.rho: Spearman (average ranks for ties) of a reading with d over the task's dial states with a finite value of that reading; undefined when fewer than 6 such states or the reading is constant over them
rule.tracks: rho defined and its two-sided permutation p (n_perm permutations of d over the states, seeded perm_seed) under alpha
rule.beats_kl: the reading tracks on the task and |rho| - |rho_KL| >= kl_margin (|rho_KL| taken as 0 when KL's rho is undefined)
rule.kl_margin_source: the card's smallest gap; E275's sampling floor on correlations of these readings with E_b over the procedural states moved up to 0.24 (experiments/claim2_needed/results/predictions.json sampling_floor)
rule.construction_source: gate-5 review (2026-11-24): the dial's reuse end is a gain per VPD subcomponent and the re-gating share is computed on the same decomposition, so the share follows the dial by construction; it is scored and reported beside the cheap readings (beats_kl per task) as a check that the dial was built as meant, and never counts for rival a
rule.verdict: readable tasks R. |R| < 3: 'no call'. Else 'rival a' (claim 2: a cheap reading measures reuse on realistic tasks beyond KL) when one cheap reading (steering or effective rank, not the construction check) beats KL with the same sign of rho on at least max(3, |R| - 1) tasks of R; otherwise 'rival b'
rule.gain_check: per task: rho of the read gain (the reader's gain.lo) with d; the gain tracking d (p < alpha) with |rho| > gain_rho_max flags the task (|rho| > 0.3 alone flagged 2 of 4 stub tasks whose gain was pure noise: over 15 states a null rho has sd ~0.27) 'the gain moves along the dial' (reported; the rule above still reads it): every arm stops at one target, so a reading that tracks d could be tracking a residual gain difference
rule.gain_rho_max_source: gate-5 review (2026-11-24): a flag, not part of the verdict, so not set from a floor; the rehearsal's calibrate gains at stop give the overshoot it is read against
rule.eb_check: per task with E_b over K on its dial states: Spearman(E_b over K, d) <= eb_rho_max, else the task is flagged 'the dial does not move the definition' (reported; the rule above still reads it). Not evidence: E_b is close to a gain share by construction
rule.placement: per task, each ordinary fine-tune, E256's saved SFT states and E256/E260's saved RL states (rl, rlg) are placed on the dial per reading: the dial level whose mean reading is nearest, and the fraction of dial states the reading puts on the reuse side of it; descriptive, beside each state's own gain against the target
rule.edge_cases_checked: score.py on made-up states (~/commute-data/scratch/compare-lead/p263-writer/stub.py, score_<case>.json, rerun 2026-11-24 after the gate-5 amendments): rival-a states -> 'rival a'; rival-b states (KL rises along the dial, steering and erank flat or weak) -> 'rival b'; every reading constant (residual share graded) -> every rho undefined, nothing tracks -> 'rival b'; two penalised arms missing on every task -> one penalised level, dial_order undefined, every task unreadable -> 'no call'; one task only -> 'no call'; the penalised arms' residual share collapsed near 0 in random order with the readings of rival a -> dial_order under 0.8, every task unreadable -> 'no call'; the share alone tracking the dial (steering, erank flat) -> 'rival b'. The do-nothing never enters a dial (it does not reach the target), so a run of do-nothings is 'no call'. Ties in d within a level: average ranks. KL undefined: |rho_KL| taken as 0
rule.spread: a task in spread_tasks is readable only if also its three betas' residual shares fall in order (dial_order, as for every task) and the dial's top and bottom are apart beyond the seed range: min over seeds of the share at the least-penalised beta > max over seeds at the most-penalised beta (score.dial_spread > 0); otherwise not read. Added 2026-11-24 with the step1_max loosening, whip-lead's condition
